title: Today's Picks
description: A short, rotating list of practical products Phavai is highlighting today.
intro: A few useful finds worth a quick look today. These are not full scored roundups; they are practical picks with simple context, clean shopping links, and the same rule that retail links never buy placement.
metaDescription: Today's Phavai picks: a short list of practical products with clear context and Amazon shopping links.

items.name: Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Face Wash
items.summary: A familiar oil-free face wash built around salicylic acid for people who want a straightforward drugstore cleanser.
items.bestFor: Acne-prone or oily skin routines where a rinse-off salicylic acid cleanser makes sense.
items.watchOut: Avoid layering too many acne actives at once, and patch test if your skin is dry, sensitive, or easily irritated.

items.name: TOSOWOONG Azelaic Acid 10% Face Serum
items.summary: A lightweight azelaic acid serum with niacinamide for people building a calm, blemish-conscious skincare routine.
items.bestFor: Skincare routines focused on visible redness, uneven tone, post-blemish marks, and gentle active ingredients.
items.watchOut: Introduce it slowly and avoid stacking it with strong acids or retinoids until you know how your skin responds.
